questions.questionText: ADO.NET is:
options: A set of classes that expose data access services for the .NET Framework
questions.correctAnswer: A set of classes that expose data access services for the .NET Framework
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A set of classes that expose data access services for the .NET Framework.

questions.questionText: Which data sources can be accessed consistently using ADO.NET?
options: XML, SQL Server, and sources exposed through ODBC and OLE DB
questions.correctAnswer: XML, SQL Server, and sources exposed through ODBC and OLE DB
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) XML, SQL Server, and sources exposed through ODBC and OLE DB.

questions.questionText: ADO.NET supports creating which of the following?
options: Front-end database clients and middle-layer business components
questions.correctAnswer: Front-end database clients and middle-layer business components
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Front-end database clients and middle-layer business components.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can use ADO.NET to connect to a database?
options: Windows applications, ASP.NET Web applications, and console applications
questions.correctAnswer: Windows applications, ASP.NET Web applications, and console applications
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Windows applications, ASP.NET Web applications, and console applications.

questions.questionText: In ADO.NET, what acts as a link between a data source and an application?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) .NET Framework data providers.

questions.questionText: A connection object connects to a data source by supplying authentication information in a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Connection string.

questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Forward-only and read-only.

questions.questionText: In a distributed transaction, if any participant cannot guarantee that changes are permanent:
options: Only that participant is rolled back
The complete transaction fails and all changes are rolled back
questions.correctAnswer: The complete transaction fails and all changes are rolled back
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The complete transaction fails and all changes are rolled back.
